Progressive task quota is a capability grant: a new identity starts with 2 slots, gains 2 per epoch up to 40, and falls 4 after 3 idle epochs.

The onyx gate is the quota: capability scales with verified work, so fresh clones cannot burst. Forgery resets the quota to 2, freezing rewards 6 epochs.

The atlas prices the attack: 1,000 high-quota clones need 19 epochs of work, costing 152,000; idle dunes slide back 4 slots every 3 epochs.
